Subject: MAP: benchmarking runbook & logistics — Nimbus Health POC

Hi Lila,

Great talking yesterday — per our MAP we want to get a concrete benchmarking cadence in place so your team can validate the performance profile before commit. Proposed plan (brief):

- Objective: measure 95th pct latency, throughput (tokens/s), TTFT for end-to-end flows, and concurrency behavior for your typical clinical summarization workload.
- Window: provisioned test env next week (see below) — prefer low-traffic window between 09/14–09/16 02:00–06:00 PT.
- Access: we'll provide test accounts + keys and a small dataset of 250 clinical notes.
- Deliverables: CSV with per-run metrics, runbook PDF, short exec summary.

Logistics ask: please confirm the preferred load window and whether your security team needs an IP allowlist for the test runners. I will attach the runbook and the test-account instructions once we lock the window.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: map-runbook-v1.2.pdf (runbook), test-account-keys.txt (will provide after scheduling)

Quick notes from infra/SE perspective before we hand off keys:

- Config: Llama-3-13B (quantized) variant, batch size 8, max gen 512 tokens, KV cache enabled.

Thanks Neha — Lila/Samir, calling out a couple of items we've baked into the runbook:

- Warmup: 10m initial warmup at concurrency=1 to populate KV cache.
- Canary: quick smoke at concurrency=8 to validate correctness (sampling 20 outputs).
- Primary sweep: concurrency ladder 1 -> 8 -> 32 -> 64 with 15m steady-state at each step.
- Failure policy: if p95 latency > 2s or error rate > 1% we abort and collect debug traces.

Samir — please confirm you'll upload the scrubbed dataset to the Drive folder by 09/13 EOD. Also we'll provide temporary test keys that expire in 48 hours post-run.

I'll attach a short CSV template for results.

Best,
Rafael

Subject: Benchmark run results — Nimbus Health POC (initial summary)

Team — attaching the initial results summary and the raw CSV. Highlights:

- Warmup behavior: KV warming reduced TTFT by ~18% between first and second step.
- Latency (steady-state, concurrency=32): p50=210ms, p95=890ms, p99=1.5s.
- Throughput: 740 tokens/s sustained at concurrency=32; dropped ~12% at concurrency=64 due to batching contention.
- TTFT: median first-token at 110ms after ingress; 95th at 420ms.
- Errors: transient 0.6% 5xx rate during one node rebalancing event — full traces attached.

Action items:
1) Redwood: provide quantization profile tweak to reduce p99 by ~200ms (NEHA action).
2) Nimbus: validate accuracy sampling from canary outputs and confirm acceptance threshold for p95 latency <= 1s.
3) Both: run a second sweep with tuned kernel flags (target window 09/18).

Neha — can you upload the full CSV and the debug traces to the Drive link and mark any rows with errors?

-Neha
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
